data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'q-b-l' meaning 'to accept, to love'. In Islamic tradition, Maqbulah refers to someone who is accepted and loved by Allah. The name Maqbulah carries the meaning “Accepted, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses.
